mapper.select: SELECT p.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.hq_yn='N' ORDER BY p.bsn_part_id
SELECT p.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{id} AND p.hq_yn='N'
SELECT p.bsn_part_id FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{id} AND p.hq_yn='N' FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.stlm_id FROM fin.part_stlm s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.stlm_ym=#{month} FOR UPDATE
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month} FOR SHARE

SELECT s.stlm_id,s.bsn_part_id,s.stlm_ym,s.stlm_stts_cd,s.part_std_hist_id,h.ldr_nm, s.prft_dstrb_rt,s.bsn_fee_amt,coalesce(s.psn_cnt,0) AS psn_cnt, coalesce(s.tot_sls_amt,0) AS tot_sls_amt,coalesce(s.tot_exp_amt,0) AS tot_exp_amt, coalesce(s.tot_diff_amt,0) AS tot_diff_amt,coalesce(s.tot_psn_prft_amt,0) AS tot_psn_prft_amt, s.corp_card_amt,coalesce(s.part_prft_amt,0) AS part_prft_amt,s.cnfrm_at, (SELECT a.aft_val::jsonb->>'rmrk_desc' FROM sys.data_chg_hist a WHERE a.tbl_nm='fin.part_stlm' AND a.obj_rec_id=s.stlm_id::text AND a.clmn_nm='corp_card_amt' ORDER BY a.chg_at DESC,a.data_chg_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS rmrk_desc FROM fin.part_stlm s LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part_std_hist h ON h.part_std_hist_id=s.part_std_hist_id WHERE s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.stlm_ym=#{month}

SELECT c.dev_id,d.dev_nm,c.emp_se_cd,c.real_pay_amt,c.rtrpay_acml_amt, (SELECT min(a.bgn_dt) FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=c.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < (to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month')) AS first_start FROM cst.mth_cst c JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=c.dev_id WHERE c.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND c.cst_ym=#{month} ORDER BY c.dev_id

SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT p.prj_nm,' · ' ORDER BY p.prj_nm) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} WHERE a.dev_id=#{devId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED'

SELECT i.stlm_dtl_id,i.dev_id,d.dev_nm,i.emp_se_cd,NULL::text AS project_names,i.mm_qty, i.mth_untprc_amt,i.slry_amt,i.bsn_fee_amt,i.rtrpay_amt,i.tot_exp_amt,i.diff_amt,i.prft_amt,i.rmrk_desc FROM fin.part_stlm_dtl i JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=i.dev_id WHERE i.stlm_id=#{id} ORDER BY i.dev_id
SELECT h.stlm_hist_id,h.stlm_prcs_cd,h.rsn_desc,h.prcs_user_id,h.prcs_at FROM fin.part_stlm_hist h WHERE h.stlm_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.prcs_at DESC,h.stlm_hist_id DESC

INSERT INTO fin.part_stlm(bsn_part_id,stlm_ym,corp_card_amt,created_by) VALUES(#{scope.partId},#{scope.month},#{card.corp_card_amt},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(bsn_part_id,stlm_ym) DO UPDATE SET corp_card_amt=excluded.corp_card_amt, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=excluded.created_by WHERE fin.part_stlm.stlm_stts_cd='DRAFT' RETURNING stlm_id
mapper.update: UPDATE fin.part_stlm SET part_std_hist_id=#{settlement.part_std_hist_id}, prft_dstrb_rt=#{settlement.prft_dstrb_rt},bsn_fee_amt=#{settlement.bsn_fee_amt}, psn_cnt=#{settlement.psn_cnt},tot_sls_amt=#{settlement.tot_sls_amt},tot_exp_amt=#{settlement.tot_exp_amt}, tot_diff_amt=#{settlement.tot_diff_amt},tot_psn_prft_amt=#{settlement.tot_psn_prft_amt}, part_prft_amt=#{settlement.part_prft_amt},updated_at=#{now},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE stlm_id=#{id} AND stlm_stts_cd='DRAFT'

UPDATE fin.part_stlm SET stlm_stts_cd=#{after},updated_at=#{now},updated_by=#{actor}, cnfrm_user_id=CASE WHEN #{after}='CONFIRM' THEN #{actor} ELSE cnfrm_user_id END, cnfrm_at=CASE WHEN #{after}='CONFIRM' THEN #{now} ELSE cnfrm_at END, cncl_rsn_desc=CASE WHEN #{after}='DRAFT' THEN #{reason} ELSE cncl_rsn_desc END WHERE stlm_id=#{id} AND stlm_stts_cd=#{before}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin.part_stlm_hist(stlm_id,stlm_prcs_cd,rsn_desc,prcs_user_id,prcs_at) VALUES(#{id},CASE WHEN #{after}='CONFIRM' THEN 'CONFIRM' ELSE 'CANCEL' END,#{reason},#{actor},#{now})
